howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会自动记录每次读取、编辑和终端操作，压缩成观察摘要。会话结束时汇总，下次会话自动注入相关记忆，无需重复解释代码库或决策。
howto.when: 从项目的第二个会话开始，Claude 会自动注入前一个会话的相关记忆。第一个会话用于建立记忆基础。

say.text: 这个项目之前讨论过什么？
say.note: Claude 会从记忆库中提取相关摘要。

say.text: 帮我回忆上次的架构决策。
say.note: Claude 会注入上次会话的观察。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically records every Read, Edit, and Bash action, compressing them into observations. At session end, observations are summarized; relevant ones are auto-injected into future prompts so the next session starts with context from the last one.
howto.when_en: Memory injection starts on the second session in a project. The first session seeds memory; subsequent sessions receive auto-injected context for relevant past work.

say_en.text: What was discussed about this project before?
say_en.note: Claude will retrieve relevant summaries from memory.

say_en.text: Remind me of the architecture decisions from last time.
say_en.note: Claude will inject observations from the previous session.
